original.statement: Runtime device detection and reconfiguration is now enabled by default in Cilium 1.16.0; the Helm option enableRuntimeDeviceDetection is deprecated.

corrected.statement: The Helm option enableRuntimeDeviceDetection is deprecated and will be removed in a future release, because detection and reconfiguration on changes to native network devices and their addresses is now the default.

decision.reason: [ev-540db624a6ea] says the Helm option `enableRuntimeDeviceDetection` "has been deprecated and will be removed in future release", so the subject and the deprecated change type are right. The evidence does not say `nodePort.addresses` replaces it. That option chooses which addresses NodePort uses, while the deprecated option is redundant because runtime detection is now the default. replacedBy should therefore be dropped.
